title: Sveti Nikole fire, July 2024
summary: EFFIS maps 12,051 ha burned in Sveti Nikole and dates the fire from 2024-07-28 to 2024-08-01.
Satellites recorded 1109 hotspot detections inside the mapped area on 6 of the 10 days shown, the most on 2024-07-30 (562).
The windiest day in ERA5 was 2024-07-29, averaging 15 km/h from the north with gusts to 49 km/h.
selection: Archive detections (MODIS and VIIRS, algorithm type 2 static sources excluded) inside the EFFIS perimeter buffered by 1.5 km, from two days before the EFFIS fire date to one day after the last detection day of the fire's run (at most 2 empty days in between), 10 days at most 21.

weather.source: ERA5 reanalysis via Open-Meteo archive API
weather.notes: Hourly values at the ERA5 cell nearest the perimeter centroid (about 25 km grid): regional weather, not the fire's own valley. Noon = 11:00 UTC; noon rain is the 24 h total up to that hour.
